reason: The hypothesis proposes a new multi-scale integration of DFT phonon calculations with MD simulations of chemical disorder to derive a corrected effective Debye temperature for HfNbTaTiZr, specifically to decouple lattice thermal conductivity. No passage combines these methods for this alloy or for thermal transport prediction; the passages separately address MD for mechanical properties, DFT for phonons in other HEAs, or Debye models from elastic constants. The idea of using this integration to achieve a quantified 25% error reduction and a falsification test against experimental lattice conductivity is not found in the literature.
